page_title: TOR 2-3 ACM | Torino v AC Milan 08/12/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+4' Daniele Chiffi couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Guillermo Maripan (Torino) and blew his whistle.
90' We will have 5 min. of added time.
90' Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) has a goal ruled out for offside!
88' Marco Landucci prepares a substitution. Alexis Saelemaekers (AC Milan) is replaced by Pervis Estupinan.
84' The referee signals a substitution. Cyril Ngonge (Torino) is brought on as a substitute for Valentino Lazaro.
84' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Niels Nkounkou (Torino) will replace Marcus Pedersen.
84' Marco Baroni decides to make a substitution. Che Adams will be replaced by Zakaria Aboukhlal (Torino).
81' Daniele Chiffi interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Marcus Pedersen (Torino).
78' The manager has been forced to make a substitution and the injured Adrien Tameze leaves the pitch to be replaced by Adam Masina (Torino).
77' 2 - 3 Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) converts a killer cross with a precise low shot that goes into the bottom right corner. What a brilliant finish!
74' Looks like Adrien Tameze (Torino) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
74' AC Milan have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
74' The corner from Luka Modric (AC Milan) is intercepted by the defence.
71' Marcus Pedersen (Torino) commits a foul and Daniele Chiffi immediately signals a free kick.
71' Nikola Vlasic (Torino) attempts to find Duvan Zapata, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone.
70' A cross into the box from Ruben Loftus-Cheek (AC Milan) is cleared.

67' 2 - 2 What a wonderful finish! Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) latches on to an inch-perfect cross into the box and drills a low shot into the bottom left corner. There are not enough superlatives to describe that goal.
66' Substitution. Davide Bartesaghi makes way for Christian Pulisic (AC Milan).
62' Marcus Pedersen (Torino) beats an opponent and drives towards the edge of the penalty area. He steadies himself and hits a tremendous shot that flashes a whisker past the left post.
59' Marco Baroni has decided to make a change. Cesare Casadei (Torino) replaces Faustino Anjorin.
59' Alexis Saelemaekers (AC Milan) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
58' Alexis Saelemaekers (AC Milan) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
56' Faustino Anjorin (Torino) takes out his opponent with a nasty challenge and is relieved when the referee only gives him a booking.

56' Ruben Loftus-Cheek (AC Milan) rises above the opponent's defence and heads a precise cross towards the bottom left corner. The effort, however, is blocked by Franco Israel, who pulls off a stunning save!
54' Alexis Saelemaekers (AC Milan) is unable to feed an accurate cross into the box.
53' Valentino Lazaro (Torino) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Daniele Chiffi had an easy-decision to make.
53' Ruben Loftus-Cheek (AC Milan) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
51' Adrien Tameze (Torino) knocks his opponent down with an over-the-top tackle. AC Milan are awarded a free kick from a dangerous position.
50' Faustino Anjorin (Torino) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Daniele Chiffi blows his whistle for a foul.
49' A precise low pass is received by Strahinja Pavlovic (AC Milan), who makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box, but his poorly placed shot sails well over the bar.
49' A cross from Alexis Saelemaekers (AC Milan) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+5' The end of the first half.
45+1' Adrien Rabiot (AC Milan) has a first-time shot at goal. It's a good effort from the edge of the box, but flies just a whisker past the left post.
45' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
45' An attempted cross from Davide Bartesaghi (AC Milan) is cleared.
44' Samuele Ricci (AC Milan) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit cross to the back post. The ball goes out of play and Torino will have a goal kick.
41' Christopher Nkunku (AC Milan) attempts to find his teammate with a short pass into the box. Adrien Rabiot collects the ball, but his attack is thwarted by the defence.
40' Luka Modric (AC Milan) delivers a poor cross from a free kick as one of the defenders comfortably clears it away.
39' Daniele Chiffi blows his whistle. Duvan Zapata (Torino) commits a foul after dangerous play.
38' Luka Modric (AC Milan) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.
37' The resulting set piece from AC Milan is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
36' Marcus Pedersen (Torino) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
31' Marco Landucci is forced to make an unplanned substitution as Rafael Leao suffers an injury and Samuele Ricci (AC Milan) comes on.
31' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
28' That was close by Rafael Leao (AC Milan)! He receives a pass on the edge of the box and shoots, but the ball goes inches wide of the left post.
27' A crossfield pass from Fikayo Tomori (AC Milan) fails to find any of his teammates.

24' 2 - 1 Well, this is definitely a candidate for the goal of the year. Adrien Rabiot (AC Milan) receives a precise pass and releases an excellent long-range howitzer of a strike, which finds its way into the net as it flies into the top right corner.
23' Alexis Saelemaekers (AC Milan) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Franco Israel intercepts the ball.
19' Mike Maignan (AC Milan) is awarded a yellow card for a sharp discussion with the referee. He should relax or he could be sent off.
17' 2 - 0 Goal! Duvan Zapata (Torino) beautifully controls a strongly hit pass from Nikola Vlasic inside the box. He cuts inside his marker and rifles the ball into the bottom left corner. 2:0.
17' Torino take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

16' Duvan Zapata (Torino) produces an inaccurate low pass into the box that is blocked by the one of the defenders. If this pass had slipped through, the ball would have probably ended up in the back of the net. Torino earn a corner.
14' Kristjan Asllani (Torino) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.
10' 1 - 0 Goal! Nikola Vlasic (Torino) puts the ball into the bottom right corner past the outstretched arm of Mike Maignan.
10' Nikola Vlasic (Torino) is going to take the penalty!
10' It’s a PENALTY to Torino after the VAR review!

9' Play continues despite the shouts by some Torino players for a penalty. Wait! Referee Daniele Chiffi interrupts the game right now and he will review that decision using VAR! Let's see what happens.
8' Fikayo Tomori (AC Milan) appears to handle the ball in the box, but the referee wasn't in the best position. Let's see what he decides.
6' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) plays a dangerous chip pass into the box in an attempt to set up one of his teammates, but the effort is intercepted by one of the defenders.
6' Faustino Anjorin (Torino) is penalised for holding. Daniele Chiffi signals a set piece.
3' A pass by Adrien Rabiot (AC Milan) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
3' Great teamplay by AC Milan as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are out and the match is about to start. AC Milan will have the kick-off.
Daniele Chiffi is introduced as the referee for today's match.
